decision: For this Georgia Draft Title V source, require bounded retrieval, identity validation, hashing, and cited extraction of each linked narrative and draft permit. Preserve official public-notice URLs as unextracted listing references. Do not claim public-notice PDF content was retrieved, validated, hashed, or used as evidence.

basis.snapshot: 18 listed rows; 18 narratives and 18 draft permits passed the existing identity check. Eight linked public notices were probed; six passed and two failed strict facility/application-to-site matching.
failed_notice_examples: Sewall Creek Energy Facility listing versus Sewell Creek notice spelling
Southwire - Carrollton listing versus Southwire Company notice legal name
basis.rationale: Narratives and draft permits supply the site-bound activity detail needed for broad Signals. Public notices are useful official references, but are not required to extract that detail in this bounded source. Fuzzy or alias-based identity merging would add unsupported matching authority for two optional documents. A link alone is not evidence of its contents.

implementation_contract: Validate and retain the complete, consistent listing of 18 rows as observed; keep the configured source bounded to its fixed official page and document paths.

Require the narrative and draft permit for every row in the configured scope. A missing, rejected, oversized, or failed required PDF makes the run visibly incomplete and must preserve previously accepted evidence.

Record public-notice URLs under an explicit link-only/unextracted label; exclude them from extracted companions and from page-cited claims. Do not claim all 44 linked PDFs were extracted. If the listing or a notice URL changes, preserve that source change in listing/semantic history without implying notice-content validation.

Use only extracted narrative/draft content and separately labeled listing fields for Signal interpretation. Preserve source-stated public-comment deadlines as regulatory dates, never as publication, project start, or completion dates.
Keep identity checks strict for required documents. Do not add aliases or fuzzy matching to make the two public notices pass.
required_validation: Fixture with 18 rows, 18 valid narratives, 18 valid drafts, and the two known notice name variants succeeds with 36 extracted documents and eight link-only notice references; it makes no notice-content claim.
A required narrative or draft failure rejects the run visibly and does not replace prior accepted evidence; a missing or malformed listing still fails closed.
A changed public-notice URL changes retained listing history without a fabricated PDF hash or citation; unchanged retrieval replays without duplicate Signals.

Documentation and source-health output state the 36-document extraction scope and eight unextracted notice links for the observed snapshot, and distinguish successful configured-scope retrieval from all-linked-document retrieval.
limits: This is a bounded scope decision for the current official list. It does not certify live retrieval, replay, runtime health, comprehensive Georgia coverage, or completion of GL3-011.
